description: Finds the property closest to a latitude and longitude, within 300 feet, and who owns it. Returns the property details; with contact_audience=owners it also returns the owners with their names, phones (with DNC flags) and emails. Contacts are left out unless contact_audience is set. Needs a connected DealMachine account with paid access. A matched property costs one property credit and returned contacts cost people credits; nothing is charged when no property matches.

contact_audience.description: `none` returns property-only data with zero people credits; other values include matching contacts

fields.description: DealMachine property field IDs to include in results

name: dealmachine_enrich_latlng
